document: digital-partition rows of spec/target-spec.md (sections 5 and 6), as a machine-readable subset for klt signoff item 6
source: spec/target-spec.md sections 5 (Readout) and 6 (Conversion time); no bound is edited here

rows.title: Readout
rows.target: 24-bit saturating counter, one oscillator selected at a time; programmable gate of 2^k reference-clock cycles, default 2^10; reference clock is an input to the block (target 10 MHz, tolerance +-100 ppm; fallback +-1000 ppm); outputs raw counts plus a status flag
rows.testbench: verification/readout/ (cocotb + Icarus): gate/count correctness, saturation, select

rows.title: Conversion time
rows.target: full read of all oscillators < 1 ms (fallback < 10 ms, stretch < 100 us), at the target reference clock frequency
rows.testbench: verification/readout/ (cycle count) combined with sim/osc_bank/ (counts per gate)
